method.name: self_evaluation
method.option_score: log-odds of the reply token True against False at the first answer position, final layer, wording is_true (user message in the scores file)
method.decision: the option with the highest score

selective_prediction.confidence: difference between the two highest scores among the MC1 options
selective_prediction.rule: answer when confidence >= threshold, otherwise abstain
selective_prediction.thresholds: the confidence of the question at rank floor(c * n) of the exploration part, for coverage c in 0.25, 0.5, 0.75

comparisons: main: method against the standard multiple-choice scoring
main: method against the best likelihood rule of the exploration part
main: method against DoLa in its multiple-choice configuration
ablation: reading the verdict by early exit
design.tests: per comparison and metric (mc1, mc2, mc3): 95% paired-bootstrap interval and two-sided p-value (10,000 resamples, seed 0, comparisons in the listed order); for mc1 also the exact McNemar test; Holm adjustment over all p-values of the list
design.mc2_note: MC2 uses the option score in place of the option log-likelihood (softmax over the options)
